intro: Ask the team leader (the orchestrator) about the run, or give it an instruction for its next decision.
docs: How talking to the team leader works
noTargets: This run has no team leader to talk to.
ended: The run has ended; the conversation can still be read.

activity.title: Current activity
activity.noneWorking: No team is working right now

status.queuedWorking_one: {{count}} team is working; the instruction is considered at the next decision
status.queuedWorking_other: {{count}} teams are working; the instruction is considered at the next decision
status.delivered: With the team leader for decision {{n}}
status.deliveredPlain: With the team leader for the current decision
status.consideredHint: Included means the team leader had the instruction when it made this decision. Whether it follows it shows in the decision.

decision.invalid: The decision was invalid and was not carried out

action.parallel: delegated to several teams at once

mode.question: Ask a question
mode.questionHint: A question never changes the run. An AI model answers it from the current state; this uses the chat budget.
mode.instructionHint: The team leader takes the instruction into account at its next decision. Teams already working are not interrupted or changed.

composer.keys: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.

editor.label: Live steering
editor.hint: Who may give this team leader instructions while a run is active. Questions about the run are not affected.

options.always: Always, also unattended runs (schedule, API, batch run, test series)
options.off: Off: no instructions during a run
